name: Wait for Sirra to Finish
label: Quest
description: This brief pause marks the moment Sirra Von'Indi deciphers the cryptic note delivered from the reclusive hermit Abercrombie. As she puts quill to paper…
intro: This brief pause marks the moment Sirra Von'Indi deciphers the cryptic note delivered from the reclusive hermit Abercrombie. As she puts quill to paper in Darkshire's Town Hall, an ominous dread settles over the room, hinting that the hermit's words are far darker than expected.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm almost finished translating that note. If you come back in a few moments I should be done.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The air grows heavy, as if a thick, black curtain is drawn over the land...
